housing.summary: Numbeo's June 2026 crowd-sourced Sandnes page reports NOK 12,666.67 monthly for a one-bedroom city-centre apartment (https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Sandnes-Norway). The City of Oslo's official newcomer guide states that Norway's usual rental deposit is three months (https://www.oslo.kommune.no/english/welcome-to-oslo/accommodation/renting-a-home/). Norway's official Ny i Norge checklist calls FINN the largest property-listing website (https://www.nyinorge.no/en/arrival/checklist/).

banking.summary: DNB's official newcomer guidance says a newcomer needs a Norwegian identity number (national identity number or D-number), valid identification and in-branch identity verification (https://www.dnb.no/kundeprogram/bli-kunde/ny-i-norge?la=NO). DNB's accepted-ID page lists an unexpired Norwegian or foreign passport, Norwegian immigrant passport, Norwegian refugee travel document, Norwegian national ID card, EU/EEA national ID card, qualifying Norwegian driving licence, or photo bank card from another bank (https://www.dnb.no/en/help-and-guidance/customer-information).
required_docs: Norwegian identity number (national identity number or D-number)
Valid, unexpired accepted proof of identity presented at a bank branch

schools.summary: Sandnes International School states that it offers the International Baccalaureate Primary Years Programme for ages 6-12 and Middle Years Programme for ages 13-16 (https://sdis.no/international-baccalaureate/). Sandnes municipality provides its local school and school-catchment directory at https://www.sandnes.kommune.no/sti/barn-unge-og-familie/skole/skoler-i-sandnes/.

legal_admin.summary: Norway's official newcomer checklist makes the arrival step conditional: EU/EEA citizens staying at least three months must obtain a police registration certificate; non-EU/EEA citizens working or staying over 90 days need a residence permit; anyone staying at least six months must register the move to Norway (https://www.nyinorge.no/en/arrival/checklist/).
legal_admin.registration_step: EU/EEA: register with the police and obtain a registration certificate for stays of three months or more. Non-EU/EEA: obtain a residence permit for work or stays over 90 days. For stays of at least six months, register the move to Norway.

tax_finance.summary: Foreign workers need a tax deduction card and a Norwegian identification number (D-number or national identity number). A newcomer without either number obtains one through the tax-card process by completing RF-1209, booking an ID-check appointment and bringing the form; an employer may alternatively apply for the tax card (https://www.skatteetaten.no/en/forms/tax-deduction-card-for-foreign-citizens).
tax_finance.tax_id_name: D-number or Norwegian national identity number

transport.summary: Kolumbus is the local network; Sandnes is a one-zone journey in the Nord-Jæren area (https://www.kolumbus.no/en/help-and-contact/frequently-asked-questions/zones/), and the adult one-zone 30-day ticket costs NOK 791 (https://www.kolumbus.no/en/tickets/-prices-and-products/30-dayticket/). EU/EEA licences can be exchanged without new tests (https://www.vegvesen.no/en/driving-licences/driving-licence-holders/foreign-driving-licence-in-norway/exchanging-eueea-driving-licences/); only licences from the listed non-EU/EEA countries can be exchanged (https://www.vegvesen.no/en/driving-licences/driving-licence-holders/foreign-driving-licence-in-norway/exchange-of-driving-licences-from-countries-outside-the-eueea/). Residents registered in the National Population Register are entitled to a GP; D-number holders generally are not, except specified groups, but remain entitled to necessary municipal medical treatment (https://www.helsenorge.no/en/gp/about-gp/the-right-to-a-doctor/).
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEA licences may be exchanged for the corresponding Norwegian category without new tests. Non-EU/EEA exchange is available only for licences from Australia, Canada, Israel, Monaco, New Zealand, San Marino, South Korea, USA, UK, Switzerland, Japan and Greenland; other non-EU/EEA licences cannot be exchanged.
transport.healthcare_registration: Register as resident in Norway's National Population Register to be entitled to a General Practitioner (fastlege). D-number holders generally are not entitled to a GP except specified groups, but the municipality must provide necessary medical treatment.
